author: Zac17
quote: Honestly, thank you Capcom, you've outdone yourself this year. You truly are the best company. If I were to talk about the game, it would take me a long time to write.

author: Zac17
quote: Honestly, I didn't expect the game to be this bad. I don't know where they went with that huge development budget, aside from the problems and the low FPS. What is this, Rockstar?

author: Zac17
quote: The game is excellent, but its only drawback is its time. and I wish it had been released at a time similar to Resident Evil 4 Remake.
